svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Noema architecture and data flow
svg.desc: Clients call the Noema API. The turn orchestrator runs the decision engine (an ensemble of small Bedrock models) and a speculative generation attempt concurrently, commits the answer when the decided spec agrees (or restarts invisibly), streams it back over SSE and persists the turn. All model calls go to Amazon Bedrock in the tenant's own AWS account via STS AssumeRole with an ExternalId.
svg.text: Small models decide, big models answer · Phase 1 MVP as built (v0.1.0)
2 uvicorn processes per 2-vCPU pod · HTTPS + SSE · typed errors
one call per member × question · backup requests
linear pool · confidence · calibration per stage
native · Jev · OpenAI facade · hierarchical · L2 cache
attempt FSM · holdback buffer · invisible restart
PDF sanitize · Docling · OCR · HEIC → PNG
every model is a config entry
Decisions and generation start together; the attempt commits when its spec equals the decided spec, otherwise it restarts invisibly. The client only sees the committed text.
